scope: Windows Qt 6.11.2 static MinGW native AgentEngine response and setup callbacks

reproducedDefects.trigger: A textDelta observer cancels the current JSON response and immediately submits a replacement turn.
reproducedDefects.observed: The old response continues through tool and completion state, interrupts the replacement, and no replacement text is delivered.

reproducedDefects.trigger: A textDelta observer destroys the engine during an SSE response; fixture protects its former storage with PAGE_NOACCESS.
reproducedDefects.observed: The original parser continues accessing destroyed engine state and terminates with Windows access violation 0xC0000005.

reproducedDefects.trigger: Destroy the engine during an SSE reasoning callback while its network backend is delivering a reply signal.
reproducedDefects.observed: A first complete run passed, but a subsequent focused run crashed in QNetworkReply::downloadProgress/doActivate after synchronous manager destruction. The targeted Google SSE reasoning row then reproduced immediately.

fix: Stop parsing buffered SSE events, terminal JSON, recursive native content blocks and subsequent tool calls after a callback changes turn generation, cancels the turn or destroys its owner.
Guard the finish callback against reply replacement while draining pending data.
Guard model-fallback publication before scheduling another request.
Keep a value copy of the message preparer and provider while calling it; abort the old request path after callback cancellation, replacement or destruction.

Deliver readyRead/finished to the engine with queued connections bound to the originating reply and turn generation. Engine observers run outside the network backend signal frame; stale queued signals cannot finish a replacement reply.

streamDimensions: cancel, immediate replacement and protected-storage destruction
setupDimensions: message preparer and model fallback observer
cancel, immediate replacement and protected-storage destruction
assertions: Old buffered tool calls never write stale.txt

limits: Local loopback HTTP fixtures only; no live model or upstream paired run.
Windows protected-storage checks establish the tested callback boundaries, not universal race or lifetime safety.
This work does not add missing provider protocols, authentication or complete feature parity.
